description_en: Queries a list of ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instances in a specified region and returns basic information about each instance, such as its endpoints and specification limits
description_zh: 查询指定地域下的云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版实例列表以及各实例的基本信息，包括实例接入点、实例规格上限等信息
kebab_example: aliyun amqp-open list-instances --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 1 --resource-group-id rg-aekzu74zjgdu4mq --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstances

parameters.help_en: The token to retrieve the next page of results. If this is your first query, leave this parameter empty
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记当前查询结束的位置，以便下一次调用时作为参数传入，继续翻页。首次调用或返回最后一页时，取值为空字符串
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. The recommended value is from 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 最大结果集。建议取值在1~100之间
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group that contains the instance
parameters.name: resource_group_id

AutoRenewInstance.description_en: Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the instance

ClassicEndpoint.description_en: The classic network endpoint. This parameter is deprecated
ClassicEndpoint.description_zh: 经典接入点，该参数不再使用

Edition.description_en:
The deployment architecture, which is applicable only to Serverless Edition instances. Valid values:

shared: A shared architecture, used for reserved, elastic (shared), and pay-as-you-go instances.

dedicated: A dedicated architecture, used for reserved and elastic (dedicated) instances
Edition.description_zh:
Serverless实例部署架构，取值如下：

shared：共享架构，适用预留+弹性（共享）以及按量付费版本。

dedicated：独享架构，适用预留+弹性（独享）版本

EncryptedInstance.description_en: Indicates whether storage encryption is enabled for the instance
EncryptedInstance.description_zh: 实例数据存储是否开启存储加密

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration timestamp of the instance, in milliseconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例过期的时间戳，单位：毫秒

InstanceType.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

professional: Professional Edition

enterprise: Enterprise Edition

vip: Platinum Edition

<props="china">

serverless: Serverless Edition

</props>
InstanceType.description_zh:
实例类型。

PROFESSIONAL：专业版

ENTERPRISE：企业版

VIP：铂金版

<props="china">- SERVERLESS：Serverless版</props>

KmsKeyId.description_en: The ID of the KMS key used for data disk encryption
KmsKeyId.description_zh: 后端存储使用数据盘对应的KMS密钥ID

ListenerMode.description_en: The port listener mode of the instance. `tcp_and_ssl` enables both port `5672` and port `5671`, while `ssl_only` enables only port `5671`
ListenerMode.description_zh:
实例端口监听模式：tcp_and_ssl或者ssl_only。
tcp_and_ssl：同时开启5672和5671端口
ssl_only：仅开启5671端口
ListenerMode.title_zh:
实例端口监听模式：tcp_and_ssl或者ssl_only。
tcp_and_ssl：同时开启5672和5671端口
ssl_only：仅开启5671端口

MaxEipTps.description_en: The peak transactions per second (TPS) of the instance over the public network
MaxEipTps.description_zh: 实例的公网TPS流量峰值，单位：条/秒

MaxQueue.description_en: The maximum number of queues for the instance
MaxQueue.description_zh: 实例的Queue的数量上限，单位：个

MaxTps.description_en: The peak transactions per second (TPS) of the instance over the private network
MaxTps.description_zh: 实例的私网TPS流量峰值，单位：条/秒

MaxVhost.description_en: The maximum number of vhosts for the instance
MaxVhost.description_zh: 实例的Vhost的数量上限，单位：个

OrderCreateTime.description_en: The creation timestamp of the order, in milliseconds
OrderCreateTime.description_zh: 订单创建的时间戳，单位：毫秒

OrderType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

PRE_PAID: The instance uses the subscription billing method.

POST_PAID: The instance uses the pay-as-you-go billing method
OrderType.description_zh:
订单类型。
PRE_PAID：预付费。
POST_PAID：后付费

PrivateEndpoint.description_en: The VPC endpoint of the instance

ProvisionedCapacity.description_en: The reserved TPS capacity for reserved and elastic instances
ProvisionedCapacity.description_zh: 预留+弹性实例的预留TPS容量

PublicEndpoint.description_en: The public endpoint of the instance

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs. This security group is used for PrivateLink endpoint creation
SecurityGroupId.description_zh: 创建实例填写的安全组，用于创建privateLink接入点
SecurityGroupId.title_zh: 安全组，用户创建pvl接入点。

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:

DEPLOYING: The instance is being deployed.

EXPIRED: The instance has expired.

SERVING: The instance is running.

RELEASED: The instance is released
Status.description_zh:
实例状态。取值如下：

DEPLOYING：实例部署中

EXPIRED：实例已过期

SERVING：实例服务中

RELEASED：实例已被释放

StorageSize.description_en:
The storage capacity of the disk. Unit: GB.

This parameter returns a value of -1 for Professional Edition and Enterprise Edition instances, to which it does not apply
StorageSize.description_zh:
磁盘容量，单位：GB。
专业版实例和企业版实例无此参数，返回-1

SupportEIP.description_en: Indicates whether the instance supports EIPs

Tags.description_en: The tags attached to the instance

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC in which the instance resides. This VPC is used for PrivateLink endpoint creation
VpcId.description_zh: 创建实例填写的VPCID，用于创建privateLink接入点

VswitchIds.description_en: The IDs of the VSwitches to which the instance is connected. These VSwitches are used for PrivateLink endpoint creation
VswitchIds.description_zh: 创建实例填写的vswitchId，用于创建privateLink接入点

items.description_en: A VSwitch ID to which the instance is connected

VswitchIds.title_zh: 创建实例时，用于创建privateLink接入点参数。必须为两个（除个别地域外）。

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page of results. If this field is empty, it means all results have been returned
NextToken.description_zh: 表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕
